curated_crossover_picks.title: Recursion
curated_crossover_picks.author: Blake Crouch
curated_crossover_picks.hook: NYPD detective Barry Sutton investigates 'False Memory Syndrome'—a phenomenon driving victims mad with memories of lives they never lived—colliding with a neuroscientist who invented a way to replay and alter time.

curated_crossover_picks.title: Dark Matter
curated_crossover_picks.author: Blake Crouch
curated_crossover_picks.hook: A kidnapped physicist wakes up in a world where his life took a completely different path, forcing him to race through the multiverse to return to his family.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The 7 1/2 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle
curated_crossover_picks.author: Stuart Turton
curated_crossover_picks.hook: Agatha Christie meets Groundhog Day and Quantum Leap: Aiden Bishop must solve a murder at Blackheath Manor by waking up each day in the body of a different guest.

curated_crossover_picks.author: Stephen King
curated_crossover_picks.hook: High school teacher Jake Epping steps through a temporal portal in a diner pantry back to 1958 on a mission to investigate and prevent the JFK assassination.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The Caves of Steel
curated_crossover_picks.author: Isaac Asimov
curated_crossover_picks.hook: The ultimate sci-fi detective noir: NYPD homicide detective Elijah Baley is partnered with a humanoid robot, R. Daneel Olivaw, to solve a locked-room murder in Spacetown.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The Gone World
curated_crossover_picks.author: Tom Sweterlitsch
curated_crossover_picks.hook: NCIS special agent Shannon Moss travels into possible futures via deep-space time slip to solve the brutal murder of a Navy SEAL's family and stop an approaching temporal apocalypse.

curated_crossover_picks.title: And Then There Were None
curated_crossover_picks.author: Agatha Christie
curated_crossover_picks.hook: Ten strangers with dark secrets are lured to an isolated island off the Devon coast and picked off one by one in the bestselling mystery of all time.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The Time Machine
curated_crossover_picks.author: H.G. Wells
curated_crossover_picks.hook: The foundational time-travel thriller following a Victorian scientist 800,000 years into the future to unravel the dark mystery of the Eloi and Morlocks.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
curated_crossover_picks.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
curated_crossover_picks.hook: Twelve iconic detective investigations by Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, remastered in modern typography.

curated_crossover_picks.title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
curated_crossover_picks.author: Agatha Christie
curated_crossover_picks.hook: Hercule Poirot's debut murder investigation—a locked-room poisoning at a country manor full of red herrings.

curated_crossover_picks.title: Short Science Fiction Collection (Minority Report / Second Variety)
curated_crossover_picks.author: Philip K. Dick
curated_crossover_picks.hook: Mind-bending sci-fi crime and temporal paranoia tales from the master of speculative noir.
